node.title: F at dimension 1: pencils meet D_j in at most n/j points (VOTING)
node.statement: For a gcd-trivial pencil l_0 + t l_1: each x in H roots the member at a UNIQUE parameter t_x = -l_0(x)/l_1(x) (shared roots excluded by gcd-triviality; l_1(x)=0 gives no vote). A D_j member needs j votes; n votes exist. Hence <= n/j members (+1 for the leading-coefficient degeneracy). Far below the n^{B_F} target.
